intent: When a bomb chain reaction finishes, a number popup showing how many bombs were in the chain rises above the player whose bomb started it, fading out over 3 seconds. Every player gets it, not just the local one.
accept: When a chain of bombs has finished exploding, the player who started it has a popup above them showing the chain's bomb count (a single bomb shows 1)
The popup floats upward, fades gradually over 3 seconds and then disappears
It appears for every player equally, including bots and other players, not only the local player
A test shows the chain count and event counter on the starting player's data increase after a chain of 3 bombs
